aboutpara: I'm a Senior Software Engineer on the Super Intelligence team at Microsoft AI, building AI capabilities across the Microsoft ecosystem—models for text, image, audio, and video. Previously, on Intercom's AI Agent Team, I shipped large-scale conversational AI infrastructure for chat, email, and voice, powering 30,000+ businesses with autonomous, context-aware agents backed by LLMs and robust backends. Before that, at respond.io, I led AI agent messaging infrastructure supporting 13 million daily conversations. I care about scalable systems, reliability, and products that meaningfully advance how people use AI.

experiences.position: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft - London, UK
bullets: Building AI capabilities for the Microsoft ecosystem as part of the Super Intelligence team.
Developing models for text, image generation, audio, and video to support the future of AI.

experiences.position: Product Engineer 3 at Intercom - London, UK
bullets: As part of Intercom's AI Agent Team, helped build large-scale conversational AI infrastructure for chat, email, and voice automation—powering over 30,000 businesses worldwide.
Worked toward autonomous, context-aware agents that combine advanced LLMs with robust backend architecture to deliver reliable, human-like interactions.

Tech: Ruby on Rails, Golang, TypeScript, Ember, React, PlanetScale, AWS (Lambda, EC2, SQS, DynamoDB, ElasticSearch), Redis, Terraform, Datadog, Honeycomb, Sentry, Buildkite, Anthropic Claude, Cursor, Figma, RAG frameworks.

experiences.position: Senior AI Engineer at respond.io - Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
bullets: Led the development of AI agent messaging infrastructure supporting 13 million daily conversations across multiple communication channels.
Focused on delivering low-latency, reliable, and scalable backend systems for enterprise-level customer support AI agents.
Solved complex backend challenges and built distributed infrastructure enabling AI agents to handle 13M+ daily messages with high availability.
Optimized conversation workflows by refactoring core modules and improving server configurations, reducing response time from 700 ms to 100 ms and boosting user satisfaction by 30%.
Enhanced push notification systems through batching and delivery optimization, cutting average delivery time from 10 s to 2 s for faster user engagement.
Collaborated with a cross-functional team of 15 engineers, ensuring smooth product delivery, scalability, and performance across global deployments.
Tech: Node.js, Golang, TypeScript, RDS, DynamoDB, Redis, SQS, Lambdas, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, Docker, Buildkite.

experiences.position: Senior Software Engineer at Nimblebot - Remote
bullets: Worked at Nimblebot, a premier provider of design and development services for industry leaders and government organizations (e.g., PayPal, Coursera, MIT, GitHub, HBO, Saudi Tourism Authority, Al Futtaim).
Led the tech team as a product engineer; focused on creating products from a customer perspective.
Crafted scalable architectures and built robust systems for web and mobile applications.
Spearheaded the development of the Hyyp mobile application, a social impact network for web 3.0 users.
Ensured the tech process aligns with user needs and market demands.

Mission 4: Engineered a robust biotech research SaaS platform that streamlined data analysis processes, reducing project turnaround times by 40% and enabling researchers to manage 250+ active projects concurrently with improved accuracy. Added new modules and features, and wrote unit tests for the existing codebase. Collaborated with a large team in an agile setup. Tech stack: Angular, C#, OData, Breeze, Jasmine, Azure DevOps. System used by thousands of people and hundreds of companies globally, impacting millions.
Mission 3: Developed a SaaS security platform with integration support for HR data export. Tech stack: PHP, Symfony. Platform used by millions of users.
Mission 2: Created a healthcare portal for families to track vitals, doctor appointments, prescriptions, etc. Tech stack: Vue.js, Jest, Node.js. Portal used by millions of families in Canada.
Mission 1: Built a drag-and-drop form builder for doctors to create patient forms in hospitals. Tech stack: Vue.js, Node.js. Tool used daily by millions of doctors.
Developed and maintained scalable web applications using Node.js, Golang, and PHP.
Built and optimized RESTful APIs, integrated Vue.js and Angular for the front end, and managed MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB databases.
Deployed applications on AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, DynamoDB) and implemented CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitHub Actions.
Ensured security best practices with OAuth 2.0, JWT, and RBAC while optimizing system performance.
Followed Agile methodologies, conducted code reviews, and documented requirements, planning, and infrastructure.
